transcript: Rain all day, the good kind that makes you want to stay in but I had a whole list of errands so I just went and did them anyway. Grocery store was a madhouse, everyone stocking up like a storm was coming instead of just a normal Saturday. Got the boring stuff done, dry cleaning, refilled a prescription, and honestly it felt kind of satisfying to just clear the list. Made soup for dinner. Nothing exciting today and that's fine.

Lazy Sunday, the best kind. Maya came over and we just put on a movie and didn't really talk for two hours, which is exactly what I needed. She brought popcorn from that place downtown, the kettle corn, way too much sugar but whatever. We talked a little afterward about nothing in particular. Days like this don't feel like they need a point.

Met my new manager for real today, Priya. Overcast out, that flat gray light where the whole morning feels like it's still deciding whether to wake up. Anyway, first one-on-one and honestly I went in braced for it to be awkward, new manager transitions always are, but she asked good questions. Actually listened to the answers instead of just waiting for her turn to talk. Asked what's been frustrating about the team setup, which nobody's asked me directly in like a year. I don't want to get ahead of myself, first impressions can be wrong, but cautiously, this feels okay. Maybe even good.

Drizzly commute, nothing special. Traffic was lighter than usual though so small win there. Work was just meetings back to back, the kind where you leave more tired than when you started even though you didn't do anything. Grabbed a sandwich at my desk. Looking forward to just going home and doing nothing tonight.

Small good thing happened today, one of the components I built last month shipped without any bug reports, which sounds like nothing but for a project that size it's actually kind of a big deal. Nobody made a fuss about it, but I noticed, and I'm letting myself feel good about it for a second before moving on to the next thing. Otherwise pretty standard Thursday, coffee, code review, a walk at lunch because it wasn't raining for once.

Drinks with Tom after work, the usual spot near his place. He's mid one of his classic spirals about whether to switch jobs, going back and forth for like the third month in a row, and honestly I just let him talk it out because that's what he needs, not advice. Two beers in and we were laughing about something completely unrelated, some story from college that gets funnier every time one of us tells it wrong. Good to just sit with a friend and not think about work for a couple hours.

Saturday errands, the unglamorous kind. Returned a package, got the car's oil changed finally after putting it off for weeks, picked up new running shoes since the old ones are basically flat now. Quiet day otherwise. Thinking about actually starting to run again tomorrow, we'll see if that survives contact with an actual alarm clock.

Okay, I actually did it. Went for a run this morning, first one in probably eight months, and it was rough, I'm not going to pretend otherwise. Made it maybe a mile and a half before I had to walk, completely out of breath, legs already complaining. But I'm calling it week one of trying the couch to five k thing again, the app with the intervals. There's something about the cold morning air and just being outside moving that clears something out of my head that nothing else really does. I want to actually stick with it this time. We'll see.

Overcast again, one of those Mondays where the sky just sort of sits there gray and unmoving and you can feel it dragging your mood down before you've even had coffee. Nothing bad happened, just flat. Dragged myself through the morning meetings. Legs still sore from yesterday's run, that's something at least, a good kind of tired mixed in with the regular kind.

Day off, spent most of it doing basically nothing, which I don't get to say very often. Read a little, did some laundry, took a long shower. Sometimes the most restorative thing is a day with zero plan attached to it. Not much else to report.

Run number two, and my legs are letting me know about it in no uncertain terms. Sore in that deep muscle way that means I'm actually doing something. Went a little further today before the walk breaks kicked in, so I'm counting that as progress even though it didn't feel like much in the moment. Cold out, breath fogging, that early winter light that barely gets bright before it starts fading again.

Bad design review today. Not catastrophic, nobody yelled or anything, but I could feel the room going quiet in that specific way it does when people are being polite instead of honest, and I know what that means. Priya said some of it was solid but the core interaction just wasn't landing, and she's right, I know she's right, but I spent the whole walk home and honestly most of the evening replaying it, picking apart every choice I made in that file like each one was evidence of something bigger. Like maybe I'm not actually as good at this as I've been telling myself for years. I know that's not a fair thing to do to myself, I know one bad review isn't a verdict on anything, but knowing it and feeling it are two very different things right now. I keep rereading her comments looking for the version where they're worse than they actually were. Going to try to just close the laptop and not touch it again tonight.

Quieter night, still licking my wounds a little from yesterday if I'm honest. Didn't really feel like doing much, made a simple dinner, went to bed earlier than usual. Sometimes the right move after a bad day is just to let it be a smaller day and not force anything on top of it.

Week two of running and it was pouring the entire time, properly soaked through by the end, shoes squelching with every step. Should have been miserable but honestly there's something almost funny about committing to it in weather like that, like the rain was testing whether I actually meant it. I meant it. Made it a little further than last week before needing to walk. Small thing, but I noticed it.

Overcast Monday, the sky doing that thing again where it just refuses to commit to being anything. Restless today, hard to focus, kept getting up from my desk for no real reason. Nothing wrong exactly, just off. Coffee didn't fix it. Hoping tomorrow has some actual sun in it somewhere.

One on one with Priya today, and it went well, better than well actually. We talked through the fallout from last week's review without either of us dancing around it, and she framed it less like a failure and more like a data point, which helped more than I expected it to. She's asking good questions about where I want to grow, which is not something my old manager ever really bothered with. Cautiously, still cautiously, but I think this new setup might actually be good for me.

It's dark at four thirty now, which always takes me a few weeks every year to adjust to even though it happens every single year without fail. Commute felt like driving through dusk even though it was mid morning. There's a specific kind of tiredness that comes from the light just disappearing on you, separate from actual physical tiredness. Otherwise unremarkable day, work things, lunch at my desk.

Dinner with Maya at the new ramen place she's been talking about for weeks. Worth the hype honestly, and the company was even better than the food. We ended up talking for almost three hours, about work, about her sister's wedding planning drama, about nothing important at all. I love that we can go from deeply serious to completely ridiculous in the same conversation without it feeling weird. Walked home in the cold after, felt good.

Long week, body just tired in that end-of-week way, legs heavy, eyes heavy. Nothing bad happened, just the accumulation of five days catching up with me all at once. Ordered takeout instead of cooking, didn't feel guilty about it for once. Looking forward to sleeping in tomorrow.

Week three of the running thing, and something clicked today, I actually made it through most of the run without stopping to walk, just a little at the very end. Cold morning, that low winter sun that barely clears the rooftops, but it felt good to be out there. I think this one might actually stick this time. There's a version of me a few weeks from now that's going to be really grateful I kept showing up on the mornings I didn't want to.

Overcast Monday, the third one in a row it feels like, that same flat gray that seems to sit right behind my eyes all morning. Tired in a way that isn't really about sleep. Thanksgiving prep starting to loom on the calendar, need to figure out what I'm bringing to my parents' this year. Otherwise a slow start to the week.

Pretty mundane workday, meetings about the holiday release freeze, everyone half checked out already thinking about Thursday. Picked up a pie on the way home for Thanksgiving, one less thing to think about. Nothing else really happened, just a normal Tuesday sliding toward a break.

Grocery store was absolute chaos tonight, everyone doing their pre-Thanksgiving run at the same time apparently. Carts everywhere, checkout line practically out the door. Got everything I needed though, the cranberry thing my mom always asks me to bring, some wine, a few things for myself for the week after. Tired from the crowds more than anything physical. Tomorrow's the actual day, should be low key, just heading to my parents'.

Thanksgiving at my parents', just the three of us this year which was actually kind of nice, quieter than some years. Mom did her usual thing where she makes way too much food for three people and insists everyone take leftovers home whether they want them or not. Dad fell asleep in his chair during the football game like clockwork, same as every year. We talked about small things mostly, my running, his garden plans for spring, nothing heavy. Good, simple day. Grateful for it honestly, even the boring parts.

Leftovers for dinner again, not complaining, turkey sandwiches are honestly better than the original meal most years. Put on a movie, didn't really watch it that closely, more background than anything. Lazy end to the long weekend. Back to work Monday, trying not to think about that yet.

Ran this morning, month's basically over and I actually kept it up more weeks than not, which feels like a small win worth naming. Legs stronger than they were four weeks ago, that's not nothing. November's been a decent month overall, new manager who actually seems good, running back in the rotation, nothing catastrophic. Heading into December a little more settled than I expected to be.
